title: Five EU countries move towards first ‘return hub’ for rejected asylum seekers
summary_full: Five European Union nations are planning migrant return hubs outside the EU.  These facilities aim to process rejected asylum seekers for repatriation.  The countries hope to finalize agreements with a partner nation this year.  Human rights groups have raised concerns about potential risks to migrants.  The proposed centers are intended to operate within international legal frameworks.
